newsitem.title: USA: Dow stocks edge lower before jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Dow stocks edge lower before jobs data.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks edged lower in quiet trading Thursday, a day after closing at a record high, as investors braced for Friday's key employment report.
The Dow Jones industrial average fell 1.12 points to end at 5,932.85, according to early, unofficial results. The index closed above 5,900 for the first time Monday and at 5,933.97 Tuesday.
In the broader market, declines led gainers by a 12-11 margin, with 387 million shares changing hands on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq index inched down 2.96, or 0.24 percent, to 1,233.15.
